conflict.title: Review sync conflicts
conflict.intro: Cloud uploads are paused until you choose what to keep. Your changes remain saved on this device.
conflict.quarantineIntro: A device change is missing from the cloud copy. Synced outfits are temporarily hidden and uploads are paused. Reopen the original device or explicitly discard the missing change.
conflict.quarantined: Synced outfits are temporarily hidden and cannot be previewed or applied. This-device-only outfits remain available. Saving, importing, and enabling cloud sync are paused until you resolve the missing change.
conflict.hiddenEmpty: Synced outfits are temporarily hidden. No this-device-only outfits are available.
conflict.cloudEnablePaused: Resolve the missing change before enabling cloud sync.
conflict.paused: Cloud upload paused. Review conflicting changes to continue.
conflict.chooseExplanation: These versions changed separately. Choose which one to keep.
conflict.deleteEditExplanation: One device deleted this item while another edited it. Restoring the edit creates a new item.
conflict.privacyExplanation: One device kept this outfit locally while another enabled cloud sync. Choose which storage choice and outfit to keep.
conflict.missingExplanation: A device reported a change, but its content is missing from the cloud copy. Reopen the wardrobe on the original device to recover it, or discard the missing change.
conflict.discardConfirm: Stop waiting for this missing change? The cloud cannot restore its content. If the original device still has a local copy, you may recover it there.
conflict.resolveFailed: This conflict could not be resolved. Your local changes are still saved. Try again.

cloudflareSync.title: Sync provider
cloudflareSync.description: Cloudflare becomes the main wardrobe sync source. BC stops uploading wardrobe data. Turning this off returns to BC sync; it does not delete the Cloudflare copy.
cloudflareSync.allDevicesHint: Turn on Cloudflare sync on every device. Older devices still using BC sync will form a separate copy.
cloudflareSync.bcLegacyChanged: We cannot confirm that the old BC wardrobe is unchanged, so automatic cleanup is paused. Export a backup and check the sync mode and wardrobe on every device. After reviewing them, switch each device to Cloudflare. Do not delete the old data yet.
cloudflareSync.bcLegacyChangedShort: Old BC data needs review; automatic cleanup is paused.
cloudflareSync.notConfigured: This version has no Cloudflare service URL. Deploy and configure the service, then update the script. BC sync remains active for now.
cloudflareSync.serviceUnavailable: This version has no Cloudflare service URL. Your wardrobe remains on this device; Cloudflare sync is paused and BC will not take over automatically. Update the script or turn off this switch to use BC.
cloudflareSync.bcCleanupPending: The old BC wardrobe copy still uses space. Cleanup is submitted after a successful Cloudflare save. BC gives no receipt, so a later login must confirm removal.
cloudflareSync.bcCleanupPendingShort: The old BC copy is awaiting cleanup and still uses BC space.
cloudflareSync.bcCleanupUnknown: The old BC wardrobe copy has not been checked. If cleanup was submitted, the next login will check the result.
cloudflareSync.bcCleanupUnknownShort: The old BC copy awaits a login check.
cloudflareSync.bcCleanupVerified: A BC login readback confirmed that the old wardrobe copy is absent.
cloudflareSync.pending: Local changes waiting to sync to Cloudflare
cloudflareSync.sizeHint: UTF-8 JSON estimate for the next sync; device-only outfits are excluded.
cloudflareSync.sizeOver: The estimate exceeds the limit, so the upload may be rejected. Your local copy remains available; reduce synced content.
cloudflareSync.changeFailed: Could not switch sync providers. Check your connection or service configuration, then try again.
cloudflareSync.syncFailed: Could not finish Cloudflare sync. Check your connection and try again.
cloudflareSync.errorTooLarge: The cloud wardrobe exceeds the 8 MB limit. Reduce the content included in sync and retry. Your local copy remains available.
cloudflareSync.errorCapacityReached: This free service has reached its wardrobe or daily creation limit. Try later or check Cloudflare service capacity. Your local copy remains available.
cloudflareSync.errorWriteLimit: This key has reached the service's daily write limit (500 writes). Your local changes remain saved; retry on the next UTC day.
cloudflareSync.errorProvisioningUnavailable: The service cannot create a new cloud wardrobe. Configure the provisioning secret in the Cloudflare deployment and retry. Your local copy remains available.
cloudflareSync.keyStorage: The recovery key was submitted to BC extension settings (assumed successful; no receipt). Save another copy. Anyone with this key can access your cloud wardrobe.
cloudflareSync.keyNotSaved: The recovery key has not been submitted to BC. Copy it now and keep it safe.
cloudflareSync.keyMissing: This device cannot find the recovery key. Turn off Cloudflare sync, then import your original key.
cloudflareSync.keyDownloadFailed: Could not download the recovery key. Show the key and copy it manually.
cloudflareSync.keyCopied: Key copied. Keep it somewhere safe.
cloudflareSync.copyManually: The browser blocked copying. Select the key above and copy it manually.
cloudflareSync.keepKeySafe: Keep this key somewhere safe. Do not share it.
cloudflareSync.keyUnavailable: Could not read the recovery key. Try again; do not clear this site's data.
cloudflareSync.restoreHint: Importing saves the key on this device and attempts to submit it to BC. When you turn sync on again, this device's wardrobe will merge with the cloud wardrobe for that key. The old key still opens its old cloud wardrobe and is not revoked.
cloudflareSync.restoreFailed: Could not import the key. Check it and try again.
cloudflareSync.dashboardHint: The data page asks for your recovery key when opened. The key is not included in the link or saved by the page.
